design: Retrospective cohort study; model development and comparative validation study
sample_size_and_ca: 3,566 patients; 4,672 admissions; 4.0% patient and 3.1% admission CA proportions (rounded; exact counts not supplied)
outcome: Cardiac arrest; operational definition requires public-source verification
model_architectures: knn dtw; svc gak; knn unif; logistic; rf gini; xgboost; lightgbm; tabnn; tresnet; gmlp; pedca ft
input_modality: PEWS time series (2 baselines); static EHR (6); numerical time series (2); multimodal tabular/textual transformer (1)
feature_themes: Vitals, labs, diagnoses, medication and demographics; textualized EHR values, not original clinical notes
training_validation: Five-fold CV grouped by patient; no separate external validation
prediction_horizon: First-24h input; target outcome interval requires public verification
prediction_frequency: First-24h snapshot context recorded; exact target interval unverified
threshold: No numerical decision threshold; three operating points read from figure
reporting_limitations: Unspecified meaning of AUROC +/- variation; operating points graph-read for three models; exact target interval and operational outcome definition not publicly verified from supplied sources; duplicated baseline model description in quality fields

population: Neonates and infants <=1 year with cardiac disease
sample_size_and_ca: Initial 228 patients (22 CA); analysed 64 (16 CA, 48 matched controls); training 44 (11 CA), test 20 (5 CA)
age: Not reported (only age range specified as ≤1 year old; no mean/median value given)
ca_prevalence_raw: 9.6% (pre-test probability; 22 cardiac arrest patients among 228 total in the original cohort)
outcome: Cessation of effective cardiac mechanical function (STS); coding plus expert EHR adjudication
input_modality: Vitals, ECG-derived HRV and PVC rate, age and sex; 16 features
feature_themes: Vitals and ECG/HRV; no laboratory features; demographics included
training_validation: Patient train/test split 44/20, with 60 bootstrap iterations; no external validation
prediction_horizon: At least 2h warning; mean 17h (SD 7.5) among 16 cases; not a fixed 17h forecast
threshold: ROC-derived per bootstrap iteration; no single usable operating threshold
reporting_limitations: Only 5 test arrest patients; bootstrap procedure described but no numerical AUROC CI/SE supplied; percentage sensitivity does not identify an integer patient table; recruitment start date inconsistent
age_caveat: Mean/median age and exact neonatal fraction not reported

population: Children <18 years with congenital/acquired heart disease
sample_size_and_ca: 160 index CA cases/events and 711 unique controls; selected case-control fraction 18.37%, not population incidence
ca_prevalence_raw: Case-control ratio approximately 1:5 (160 cases:711 controls) after exclusions; background CICU IHCA rate stated as 3 events per 1000 patient days (~20 IHCA events/year)
outcome: Index IHCA resulting in CPR, local event database
feature_themes: Vitals, laboratory measures, NIRS and vasoactive score; demographics collected but not in final feature set
training_validation: Five-fold CV (80/20 per fold), control subsampling; no demonstrated external validation
prediction_horizon: 1h extracted peak AUROC; other 5/9/13h results not numerically supplied
prediction_frequency: Anytime querying after >=4h input; hourly EHR context
threshold: Unreported for Figure 2 representative fold; no demonstrated linkage to 1h AUROC
reporting_limitations: Representative confusion-matrix model attribution assumed in extraction; fold, threshold, horizon and unit unresolved; probable cohort reuse with Yu 2022; rounded PPV/NPV require comparison with exact table-derived values
age_caveat: No neonatal breakdown; cardiac disease is not equivalent to 100% congenital disease

population: General PICU; 38 patients aged 18+ in 1,145 (no CA in adult group); paediatric-only accuracy unavailable
sample_size_and_ca: 1,145 patients, 15 CA; 14,714 windows, 516 positive overall; test 229 patients (5 CA); six test matrices each contain 3,059 windows (211 positive)
ca_prevalence_raw: 15/1,145 patients (1.3%) at patient level; 516/14,714 windows (3.5%) at window level
outcome: Physician-reviewed IHCA; positive window within 3h before arrest
model_architectures: logistic; svm; random forest; xgboost; lightgbm; soft voting
input_modality: ECG/HRV, vital statistics, medication classes, demographics; 162 features recorded
feature_themes: Vitals, ECG/HRV, medications and demographics; no lab feature category
training_validation: Patient split: train 732 (6 CA), validation 184 (4 CA), test 229 (5 CA)
prediction_horizon: 5min windows labelled positive within 3h before CA; 3h preferred over 1h
threshold: Validation ROC optimal point; numerical thresholds not reported
reporting_limitations: Repeated windows and six dependent models; no intrapatient correlation or clustering adjustment supplied; 1,019/2,164 patients removed including 57 CA; 38 adults included; recruitment ends July vs August 2021
age_caveat: 38/1,145 aged 18+; neonatal age band is newborn-1 month, not exact <=28 days
